description: Today, Michael Whatley released the following statement celebrating the one year anniversary of the landmark Working Families Tax Cuts being signed into law. Marking a year of North Carolina families saving $5,700 in taxes, a secure border, American energy dominance, and policies that put money back into North Carolinians pockets such as No tax on tips, overtime, and Social Security.

title: Whatley On The One Year Anniversary of the Working Families Tax Cuts Being Signed Into Law – Michael Whatley for Senate
